title: Pakistan Ordinance Factories Board Amendment Ordinance 1983

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Ordinance Factories Board Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXVIII OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXVIII OF 1983
PAKISTAN ORDINANCE FACTORIES BOARD (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Ordnance Factories Board
Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd November, 1983.]
No. F. 17(1);83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Pakistan Ordnance Factories Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Ordinance Factories Board Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3, Ordinance XVII of 1961

ORDINANCE XXVIII OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXVIII OF 1983
PAKISTAN ORDINANCE FACTORIES BOARD (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Ordnance Factories Board
Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd November, 1983.]
No. F. 17(1);83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 3, Ordinance XVII of 1961.--In the Pakistan
Ordnance Factories Board Ordinance, 1961 (XVII of 1961), hereinafter referred
to as the said Ordinance, in section 3,-
(a) in
subsection (1), for the words "three members" the words "four
members" shall be substituted ; and
(b) in
subsection (2),-
(i) for the word
"and", occurring fax the first time, a comma shall be substituted ;
and
(ii) after the
word "Board" at the end, the words "and the fourth to be the
Member Production Co-ordination of the Board" shall be added.
